title.zh: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
title.en: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot

current_state.zh: The European Central Bank is inviting euro-zone e-commerce and mobile merchants to join a 12-month digital euro pilot starting in the second half of 2027, testing a beta CBDC ahead of a possible 2029 issuance.
current_state.en: The European Central Bank is inviting euro-zone e-commerce and mobile merchants to join a 12-month digital euro pilot starting in the second half of 2027, testing a beta CBDC ahead of a possible 2029 issuance.
